timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹63.83 Cr (+29.6% YoY), net profit ₹4.77 Cr (-21.5% YoY).
Avantel Limited’s Board, led by **D Rajasekhara Reddy**, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.20 per share (10% of ₹2 face value) for FY2025–26, pending AGM approval, payable on June 12, 2026.
Avantel received a ₹3.01 Cr purchase order amendment from Bharat Electronics Limited for power amplifiers.
On May 21, 2026, Avantel received a ₹1.92 Cr purchase order amendment from Bharat Electronics Limited for power amplifiers to be executed by September 2026.
On May 25, 2026, Avantel received a ₹28.20 Cr contract from Coast Guard Headquarters for Satcom products to be executed by August 2027.
Avantel received a ₹9.94 Cr contract from DRDO for the development and testing of GSAT satellite terminals, to be executed by December 2028.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹74.42 Cr (+34.3% YoY), net profit ₹6.81 Cr (+59.5% YoY).
Avantel's board approved the merger of its wholly owned subsidiary Imeds Global Private Limited into itself, subject to NCLT sanction.
